description: Read the file `stock.csv`. Its first line names the columns, separated by commas, and each later non-empty line is one row; the file may end with a newline. The `qty` column holds whole numbers. Return a record with `columns` (the column names in order), `rows` (the number of rows), and `total` (the sum of the `qty` column).

capabilities.description: Reads a text file from the shared store.
